concepts.why: The presence of a heterogeneous mass with solid and cystic components in the left maxillary sinus, erosion of the orbital floor and maxillary walls, and displacement of the inferior rectus muscle without invasion, are consistent with JNA.
The presence of a spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells, rare mitotic activity, and no cytologic atypia, are consistent with SNUC.

The presence of a heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus, displacement of the inferior rectus muscle without invasion, and a spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells, are consistent with ENB.
The presence of sinus pressure, facial swelling, and external deviation of the nasal septum, are consistent with IFS.
The presence of sinus pressure, facial swelling, and external deviation of the nasal septum, are consistent with NSA.
The presence of sinus pressure, facial swelling, and mild left-sided proptosis, are consistent with OC.
The presence of sinus pressure and facial swelling, are consistent with NP.
The presence of sinus pressure and facial swelling, are consistent with CS.
The presence of sinus pressure and facial swelling, are consistent with AR.
The presence of external deviation of the nasal septum, is consistent with NF.

The finding of a heterogeneous mass with solid and cystic components and no extension beyond the cribriform plate, along with the presence of multinucleated giant cells, suggests Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis.

rationales.F01: Sinus pressure and facial swelling are non-specific symptoms that could be associated with various conditions, including chronic sinusitis.
rationales.F02: External deviation of the nasal septum could be indicative of a nasal septal abscess or nasal fracture.
rationales.F04: The presence of a left nasal mass is a significant finding that could be associated with several conditions, including juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma, sinonasal undifferentiated carcinoma, and esthesioneuroblastoma.
rationales.F06: The CT scan findings of a heterogeneous mass with solid and cystic components are highly suggestive of a malignant tumor, such as juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma or sinonasal undifferentiated carcinoma.
rationales.F10: The biopsy results showing a spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells are highly suggestive of juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma.
